moa.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level gilded MOA to 30 for the full 6,000 (200 mastery per rank)
moa.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Selling/rebuilding the same Model grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: 'MOAs have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the MOA's Model alone.'
Core, Gyro, Bracket set stats/precepts and appearance only; any combination works.
Gild at Legs, Fortuna: 10 Training Debt-Bonds + 5,000 Solaris United standing, Doer rank.

hound.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level gilded Hound to 30 for the full 6,000 model mastery
hound.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Selling/rebuilding the same Model grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: 'Hounds have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the Hound's Model alone.'
Wiki: 'the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Hound crafting is 27,000 (18,000 from Models and 9,000 from their weapons).'
Each Model bundles one melee weapon, a separate 3,000-point mastery entry: Bhaira/Lacerten, Dorma/Batoten, Hec/Akaten.
Core, Bracket, Stabilizer set stats/precepts and appearance only.
Gild at Legs, Fortuna: 10 Training Debt-Bonds + 5,000 Solaris United standing, Doer rank.

Gifted Hound: vanquishing a Sister of Parvos hands over her Hound as a Companion, parts randomly rolled at Sister creation. Wiki states no gilding exemption, so it counts only as one of the 3 Model entries and only after being ranked to 30 and gilded like any other. Duplicate Model gives nothing.
Component blueprints are tradeable; completed components and built Hounds are not.

amp.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level to 30 for the full 3,000 (100 mastery per rank). Sirocco arrives gilded.
amp.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Rank 30 or gilded Amps can be donated to Onkko (Quill standing) or Little Duck (Vox Solaris standing) once milked.
notes: Wiki: 'Amps have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the weapon's Prism alone.'
Wiki: 'As there are seven Prisms plus the Mote Amp and Sirocco currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Amp crafting is 27,000.'
Scaffold and Brace set stats and appearance only.
Mote Amp is a free prebuilt that must be gilded; it gives 100 mastery per level once gilded.
Sirocco is the Drifter's Amp and is gilded on acquisition, so it only needs levelling.
Gild at Onkko (Adherent rank) or Little Duck (Hand rank).

zaw.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level to 30 for the full 3,000 (100 mastery per rank)
zaw.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Rank 30 or gilded Zaws can be donated to Hok's Anvil for Ostron standing once milked.
notes: Wiki: 'Zaws have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the weapon's Strike alone.'
Wiki: 'As there are eleven Strikes currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Zaw crafting is 33,000.'
Grip and Link set stats, stance polarity and appearance only.
Gild at Hok, Cetus: reputation rank Trusted with the Ostrons.
Plague Keewar and Plague Kripath are Operation: Plague Star parts and only sold during that event.

kitgun.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level to 30 for the full 3,000 (100 mastery per rank)
kitgun.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Selling/rebuilding the same Chamber grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: 'Kitguns have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the weapon's Chamber alone.'

Wiki: 'Note that the primary and secondary variants of each chamber share the same Mastery progression, so leveling both the primary and secondary variant of the chamber will not give more Mastery.' The Grip decides primary vs secondary, so pick whichever you want to keep.
Wiki: 'As there are six Chambers currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Kitgun crafting is 18,000.'
Grip and Loader set stats and appearance only.
Gild at Rude Zuud (Fortuna) or Father (Deimos). Catchmoon/Gaze/Rattleguts/Tombfinger come from Rude Zuud, Sporelacer/Vermisplicer from Father.

kdrive.rankRequirement: Rank 30 for the full 6,000 (200 mastery per rank). No gilding step at all.
kdrive.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Selling/rebuilding the same Board grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: the Board 'is also the only part that grants progress towards Mastery Ranking' and 'Each Board will grant 200 Mastery Points per level, accumulating to 6,000 at rank 30.'
Wiki: 'K-Drives can also be fitted with Orokin Reactors and Forma to further improve their customization, requiring no gilding, unlike traditional Modular weaponry.'
Nose, Jet and Reactor parts are cosmetic/stat only.
The free Bondi K-Drive is excluded: 'the Bondi K-Drive does not appear in the Arsenal, thus it cannot be altered or Mods, and cannot be leveled nor will it grant points towards Mastery Ranks.'
totalMastery 30000 is derived (5 boards x 6,000); the wiki states the per-board figure but no explicit type total.
Boards: Bad Baby 5,000 standing; Flatbelly 10,000 (rank 2); Needlenose 15,000 (rank 4); Runway 15,000 (rank 5) from Ventkids. Feverspine from Cambion Drift K-Drive races.

predasite.masteryComponent: Subspecies (the head, set by the captured specimen)
predasite.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level to 30 for the full 6,000 (200 mastery per rank)
predasite.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Re-revivifying the same Subspecies grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: 'Predasites have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the Predasite's Subspecies alone.'
Wiki: 'As there are three currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Predasite revivification is 18,000.'
Subspecies comes from the weakened specimen captured via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, not from a bought part.
Mutagen sets tail appearance and damage resistances; Antigen sets head/neck appearance and first polarity. Neither affects mastery.
Gild at Son: 10 Son Tokens + 5,000 Entrati standing, requires Rank 3 - Associate.

vulpaphyla.masteryComponent: Subspecies (the head, set by the captured specimen)
vulpaphyla.rankRequirement: Rank 30 before gilding; gilding resets to 0; re-level to 30 for the full 6,000 (200 mastery per rank)
vulpaphyla.sellBehaviour: Mastery already earned is permanent. Re-revivifying the same Subspecies grants nothing again.
notes: Wiki: 'Vulpaphylas have to be gilded to earn Mastery Rank points, with their progression tied to the Vulpaphyla's Subspecies alone.'
Wiki: 'As there are three currently available, the maximum amount of Mastery Rank points that can be earned from Vulpaphyla revivification is 18,000.'
Subspecies comes from the weakened specimen captured via Conservation in the Cambion Drift.
Mutagen sets tail appearance and damage resistances; Antigen sets head/neck appearance and first polarity. Neither affects mastery.
Gild at Son: 10 Son Tokens + 5,000 Entrati standing.

totals.buildsNote: 42 = 4 MOA + 3 Hound + 7 Amp (Mote and Sirocco need no build) + 11 Zaw + 6 Kitgun + 5 K-Drive + 3 Predasite + 3 Vulpaphyla. Mote Amp gild and Sirocco levelling add 6,000 more without a build.

moa: Reach Doer with Solaris United (Legs, Fortuna).
Buy/craft one of each Model: Para, Lambeo, Oloro, Nychus. Cores, Gyros, Brackets can be the cheapest available and can repeat.
Build MOA 1, level to 30, gild (10 Training Debt-Bonds + 5,000 standing), level to 30 again = 6,000.
Sell or keep after the second rank 30; mastery is banked.
hound: Reach Doer with Solaris United (Legs, Fortuna).
Collect one of each Model: Bhaira, Dorma, Hec. Vanquished Sisters drop one random Hound component blueprint each and hand over their built Hound.
Check the inherited Sister Hound's Model first; if new, use it as that Model's build.
Build/claim Hound, level to 30, gild, level to 30 again = 6,000 model + 3,000 for its bundled weapon (Lacerten/Batoten/Akaten).
Skip any duplicate-Model Hound from later Sisters; it awards nothing.
amp: Gild the free Mote Amp (rank 30 first) and re-level = 3,000.
Level Sirocco to 30 (already gilded, from The New War) = 3,000.
Reach Adherent with The Quills (Onkko) and/or Hand with Vox Solaris (Little Duck).
Build one Amp per Prism: Raplak, Shwaak, Granmu, Rahn, Cantic, Lega, Klamora. Scaffold and Brace are free choice, cheapest repeats fine.
Donate the spent Amps to Onkko or Little Duck for standing.
zaw: Reach Trusted with the Ostrons (Hok, Cetus).
Buy one of each Strike: Balla, Cyath, Dehtat, Dokrahm, Kronsh, Mewan, Ooltha, Rabvee, Sepfahn. Grip and Link can repeat; cheapest is fine.
Grab Plague Keewar and Plague Kripath during Operation: Plague Star; unavailable otherwise.
Each: build, rank 30, gild, rank 30 again = 3,000.
Donate spent Zaws to Hok's Anvil for Ostron standing.
kitgun: Build one Kitgun per Chamber: Catchmoon, Gaze, Rattleguts, Tombfinger (Rude Zuud, Fortuna), Sporelacer, Vermisplicer (Father, Deimos).
Pick primary or secondary Grip freely; the two variants of a Chamber share one mastery entry, so build only one.
Gild at Father where possible (25 Father Tokens + 5,000 Entrati standing) rather than Rude Zuud's debt-bonds.
kdrive: No gilding anywhere in this list.
Buy Boards from Ventkids as standing allows: Bad Baby (5,000), Flatbelly (10,000, rank 2), Needlenose (15,000, rank 4), Runway (15,000, rank 5).
Win Feverspine from Cambion Drift K-Drive races.
Build one K-Drive per Board and level each to 30 = 6,000 each.
Ignore the free Bondi K-Drive; it cannot be levelled and gives no mastery.
predasite: Reach Rank 3 - Associate with the Entrati (Son).
Buy and craft any Mutagen and Antigen; they never affect mastery.
Conservation-capture one weakened specimen of each Subspecies in the Cambion Drift: Vizier, Medjay, Pharaoh.
Revivify, level to 30, gild (10 Son Tokens + 5,000 standing), level to 30 again = 6,000.
vulpaphyla: Conservation-capture one weakened specimen of each Subspecies: Crescent, Panzer, Sly.
Revivify, level to 30, gild, level to 30 again = 6,000.

sharedRules.masteryIsPermanent: Wiki (Mastery Rank): 'Each individual equipment will only grant its mastery points once per variant; polarization or selling a Rank 30 equipment and then purchasing & reusing it will not grant mastery points again.'
sharedRules.gildingIsTheGate: Every modular type except K-Drive awards zero mastery until gilded; an ungilded build at rank 30 has banked nothing.
sharedRules.duplicateComponents: A second build sharing the mastery component of one already taken to gilded rank 30 awards nothing, whatever the other parts are.

sources: https://youtu.be/67XmFcfdgtA (WarframeFlo, kitgun guide - method only: Father gilding is cheaper than Rude Zuud)

unknowns.note: Wiki states 6,000 per Board but no explicit type total. 30,000 is derived from 5 mastery-granting Boards.

Wiki says the player inherits the Sister's Hound as a Companion but never states its rank or gild state. No gilding exemption is documented, and the blanket rule 'A Hound's Model will only earn Mastery Rank points once the Hound is gilded' has no carve-out, so treat the gifted Hound as needing rank 30 + gild + re-level.
Whether the bundled Hound melee (Lacerten/Batoten/Akaten) needs the Hound gilded to award its 3,000, or earns it while ungilded, is not stated.
Wiki only covers selling at Rank 30. Whether mastery banked below rank 30 is kept, and whether a rebuilt item with the same component resumes from that point, is not documented.
Zaws and Amps have documented standing donations (Hok, Onkko, Little Duck). No equivalent kitgun donation is documented.
Wiki's 27,000 counts 7 Prisms + Mote Amp + Sirocco. Whether any future prebuilt amp adds an entry is unstated.

discarded: YouTube (QuadLyStop) says Rude Zuud gilding costs 5 debt-bonds; wiki says 10 Training/Sheltered Debt-Bonds. Wiki wins.
Any transcript proper nouns and numbers: auto-generated captions mangle part names. Used only for method (gild at Father for cheaper cost, primary vs secondary grip choice).
Claim that MOA/Hound Cores, Gyros, Brackets, Stabilizers affect mastery: explicitly contradicted by wiki.
Claim that levelling both primary and secondary variants of a Kitgun chamber gives more mastery: explicitly contradicted by wiki.
Bondi K-Drive as a mastery source: wiki says it cannot be levelled and grants no mastery.
